title: 1:1 prep - Morgan Chen & Ellie Ross
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Ellie Ross (direct report)
Date: 2026-03-02 10:00am PT (30m)
Location: Zoom / huddle-room-2
Purpose: sync on current sprint priorities, unblock work on model routing prototype, check on on-call fatigue, and discuss career development next steps.

Quick context/reminder
- Ellie is IC3 (platform engineer) working on smart routing and autoscaling policy prototype for Dedicated.
- Last 1:1 (2026-02-17) we agreed: 1) unblock data joins for traffic simulator, 2) set up canary for routing policy, 3) share draft career growth plan.
- Overall I want to balance shipping a small-milestone this sprint with not overloading Ellie while she's on call next week.

Agenda (prioritized)
1) Status updates (5m)
   - Ask: what shipped since last 1:1? quick wins and small blockers.
   - Notes to prompt: traffic simulator data join status; test coverage for routing policy; PRs in review.
2) Blockers & support needed (8m)
   - Main blocker: dependencies on infra team for KV cache metrics (JIRA-2143).
   - Check if need pairing session or a ticket escalation.
   - Ask about access/permissions or infra queues delaying work.
3) On-call health + capacity (5m)
   - Ellie oncall next Tue-Fri; confirm shouts and rotations.
   - Discuss runbook gaps and whether we should pare down planned work.
4) Career growth + next steps (7m)
   - Follow up on growth draft: pick 2 concrete goals for next quarter (technical ownership + mentorship).
   - Offer sponsorship: recommend leading the routing canary launch and run the postmortem.
5) Action items & alignment (5m)
   - Confirm next steps, owners, timelines, and whether to bump to eng leads sync.

Notes to myself (things to remember to say)
- Acknowledge good work on the simulator perf improvements (reduced tail latency in local runs).
- Encourage small, visible wins this sprint to demonstrate progress for Dedicated pilot.
- Be explicit about tradeoffs: it is OK to delay noncritical tests if oncall is heavy.
- Offer to unblock infra dependency by pairing with Casey or filing a critical blocker with infra manager.

Current status snapshot (Ellie update expected)
- Traffic simulator: data join done but running into memory blowups on synthetic dataset. Hypothesis: join order + incorrect partitioning.
- Routing policy service: core logic implemented; integration tests failing intermittently on CI (timeout at 30s).
- Canary infra: canary config ready, awaiting infra permission to deploy to dedicated pool.
- PRs: two PRs open (routing-policy core logic, simulator fix); reviewers assigned but slow turnaround.

Potential quick interventions I can offer
- Approve one of the small PRs if green and safe to merge (to reduce dev context).
- Blocker escalation: if infra response >48h, I will ping infra lead and copy Eng Director.
- Pairing: offer a 90-min pairing slot tomorrow afternoon to debug the memory issue.
- Adjust scope: reduce simulator dataset size for initial end-to-end test to avoid memory blowups.

Career/growth talking points
- Suggested goals for next quarter: 1) Lead the routing canary launch end-to-end (requirements, runbook, rollout). 2) Mentor a junior on the sim infra and co-own sim test harness.
- Growth check: ask Ellie where she wants to be in 12 months (technical ladder vs. people leadership).
- Training: recommend internal course on distributed tracing and a shadowing session with SRE.

Draft action items (to capture during meeting)
- Ellie: open a short RFC for canary rollout plan and share by 2026-03-05 (owner: Ellie; due: 2026-03-05).
- Morgan: ping infra lead (Casey Nguyen) if infra ack not received by 2026-03-03 (owner: Morgan; due: 2026-03-04).
- Ellie + Morgan: pair session to debug simulator memory on 2026-03-01 3:30pm PT (owner: Ellie+Morgan; due: 2026-03-02).
- Ellie: consolidate reviewers list and nudge via Slack thread for PRs by end of day 2026-03-01 (owner: Ellie; due: 2026-03-01).
- Morgan: add mentorship objective to Ellie's growth doc and nominate her as routing-canary lead in next eng leads sync (owner: Morgan; due: 2026-03-07).

Follow-ups for next 1:1 topics (if time)
- Review canary metrics target (p95 latency, cost delta) and ensure they map to rollout success criteria.
- Postmortem template for canary rollouts.
- Lead indicator metrics for Ellie: number of successful canary steps owned, number of paired mentoring sessions.

Risks/flags to surface to manager this week
- Infra dependency for KV cache metrics could delay canary by 1 sprint.
- Ellie is scheduled for a combined on-call + major shipping week; consider deprioritizing nonessential work.

Raw notes / verbatim to capture during meeting
- "I can probably get infra to give read-only metrics by EOD if we ask specifically for namespace perms."
- "If we cut the dataset to 10% we can run end-to-end tests without OOMs."
- "I'd like to mentor a new hire on the simulator test harness next quarter."

Post-meeting: send short summary to Ellie with action items and link to RFC + PRs, and cc Avery if escalations are needed.

Related links to paste in follow-up message:
- Routing canary RFC template: confluence:ENG-PLATFORM-RUNNING-ROADMAP#routing-canary-rfc
- PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/pr/789 and github.com/redwood-inference/pr/790
- Jira: JIRA-2143 (KV-cache-metrics), JIRA-2201 (routing-ci-timeouts)

End of prep notes.
